_note: Statutory / administrative periods used by tools/submission_timeline.py. verified=true means checked against a primary source: Cap. 123 consolidated version 1.3.2026, Cap. 123A consolidated version 30.6.2024 (both uploaded 2026-11-06), or bd.gov.hk read on 2026-11-05. verified=false means not yet checked. Day counting: calendar days, start date + N (conservative; Cap. 1 counting rules not checked).

gbp_first.label: Plans submitted for the first time: refusal must be notified within N days or approval is deemed
gbp_first.ref: B(A)R reg 30(3)(a); BO s.15(1) (deemed approval unless refusal notified)

gbp_resubmission.label: Plans submitted again (not a major revision): refusal within N days from last submission

gbp_major_revision.label: Plans submitted again, so revised as to be a major revision in BA's opinion

major_revision_notice.label: BA must tell the AP/RSE/RGE that a resubmission is a major revision

enquiry_45th_day.label: Ask whether submission is fundamentally acceptable

consent.label: Consent to commence (from application, or from approval date if not concurrent)
consent.ref: B(A)R reg 32(3); BO s.15(1); PNAP ADM-19 para 39(c)

amendment.label: Alterations or additions to works already consented (reg 33): consent deemed after N days

consent_lapse.label: Consent deemed revoked if works not commenced (or suspended) for this period; renew with BA9

fast_track_aa.label: Fast-track concurrent approval and consent, simple A&A works

fast_track_cladding.label: Fast-track curtain wall / window wall / cladding repair

warehouse_2storey.label: Two-storey warehouse concurrent approval and consent

op.label: OP / TOP: refusal must be served within N days or the permit is deemed granted
op.ref: BO s.21(7) (deemed granted unless refusal served); s.21(8) if within 60 d of a s.17 performance review

pre_submission_assurance.label: Letter of assurance on pre-submission enquiry (normally)

ba10_before_commencement.label: AP furnishes RC appointment, commencement date and RC undertaking (BA10) not less than N days before commencement

ba15_material_change.label: Notice of intended material change in use (BA15): one month's notice

mw_notice_before.label: Class I / II minor works: notice before commencement

mw_completion_after.label: Minor works (all classes): certificate within N days after completion

mw_ack.label: BD acknowledgement of minor works submission (generally)

mbis_report_after_inspection.label: RI submits inspection report, certificate and repair proposal after inspection
mbis_report_after_inspection.ref: BD General Guidelines MBIS/MWIS 2015, Annex II

mbis_prenotice.label: MBIS pre-notification to statutory notice (at least 6 months)

mwis_prenotice.label: MWIS pre-notification to statutory notice (at least 2 months)

tcp_notice_before.label: AP/RSE/RGE notifies appointment of TCPs (where supervision plan required) not less than N days before commencement

rc_completion_cert.label: RC certifies completion to the AP/RSE/RGE within N days of completion

ap_completion_cert.label: AP certifies completion to the BA within N days of completion (non-demolition)

rse_completion_cert.label: RSE/RGE certifies within N days of receiving RC certificate; AP sends on within 7 days

ap_cease_notice.label: AP/RSE/RGE who ceases to act notifies the BA within N days

water_cert.label: Water authority issues water supply certificate for OP within N days of application
water_cert.ref: B(A)R reg 25A (WSD certificate sent with the reg 25(2) certificate)

top_expiry_grace.label: After TOP expires or is revoked without OP, s.21(1) occupation ban applies after N days

wr_max_times.label: Withdrawal and resubmission of the same submission, generally not more than

mbis_building_age_years.ref: BO s.30B(1); age from OP date s.30B(2)

mwis_building_age_years.ref: BO s.30C(1); age from OP date s.30C(2)

penalties._ref: BO s.40, Cap. 123 version 1.3.2026. Fine levels per Criminal Procedure Ordinance Cap. 221 Sch. 8 (level 1 $2,000; 2 $5,000; 3 $10,000; 4 $25,000; 5 $50,000; 6 $100,000) - Cap. 221 not uploaded, levels verified=false

s40_1BD_fail_mwis_notice_s30C.text: level 4 and 3 months; $2,000 per day; BA must first give a penalty notice (s.40(1BE), Sch. 7)

s40_2B_misrepresent_or_deviate.text: building works / prescribed inspection: $1,000,000 and 3 years; window inspection or minor works: $500,000 and 18 months
